name: Sidequest application health
description: Rates use unsampled completion summaries. HTTP and RPC stay separate to avoid counting the same interaction twice. Expected rejections are excluded from unexpected failures. Click trace_id in diagnostic rows to open a waterfall.

apl.apl:
['sidequest-logs']
| distinct ['attributes.environment']
| where isnotempty(['attributes.environment'])
| project key=['attributes.environment'], value=['attributes.environment']
| order by key asc

['sidequest-logs']
| distinct ['attributes.release']
| where isnotempty(['attributes.release'])
| project key=['attributes.release'], value=['attributes.release']
| order by key asc

['sidequest-logs']
| distinct ['attributes.component']
| where isnotempty(['attributes.component'])
| project key=['attributes.component'], value=['attributes.component']
| order by key asc

['sidequest-logs']
| distinct ['attributes.operation']
| where isnotempty(['attributes.operation'])
| project key=['attributes.operation'], value=['attributes.operation']
| order by key asc

charts.name: Reading this dashboard
charts.text:
Rates use unsampled completion summaries. HTTP and RPC stay separate to avoid counting the same interaction twice. Expected rejections are excluded from unexpected failures. Click trace_id in diagnostic rows to open a waterfall.

Triage: Check recent failures by release and operation, then open a sampled trace. Keep HTTP and RPC rates separate.

Full runbook: docs/observability/README.md in the Sidequest repository.

declare query_parameters (environment_filter:string="production", release_filter:string="", component_filter:string="", operation_filter:string="");
['sidequest-logs']
| extend operation=tostring(['attributes.operation']), category=tostring(['attributes.category']), component=tostring(['attributes.component']), release=tostring(['attributes.release']), outcome=tostring(['attributes.outcome']), event=tostring(['attributes.event']), account=tostring(['attributes.accountId']), session=tostring(['attributes.reportingSession']), seconds=todouble(['attributes.durationSeconds']), milliseconds=todouble(['attributes.durationMs']), provider=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.provider', '')), fingerprint=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.fingerprint', '')), errorClass=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.errorTag', '')), stage=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.failureStage', '')), eventId=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.eventId', '')), canWrite=tobool(column_ifexists('attributes.canWrite', false)), ageMs=todouble(['attributes.pendingAgeMs']), online=tobool(['attributes.online'])
| where isempty(environment_filter) or ['attributes.environment'] == environment_filter
| where isempty(release_filter) or release == release_filter
| where isempty(component_filter) or component == component_filter
| where isempty(operation_filter) or operation == operation_filter
| where body == 'operation.completed'
| where category == 'http' and operation != 'http.telemetry'
| summarize value=100.0 * countif(outcome != 'unexpected_failure') / count()

| extend operation=tostring(['attributes.operation']), category=tostring(['attributes.category']), component=tostring(['attributes.component']), release=tostring(['attributes.release']), outcome=tostring(['attributes.outcome']), event=tostring(['attributes.event']), account=tostring(['attributes.accountId']), session=tostring(['attributes.reportingSession']), seconds=todouble(['attributes.durationSeconds']), milliseconds=todouble(['attributes.durationMs']), provider=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.provider', '')), fingerprint=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.fingerprint', '')), errorClass=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.errorTag', '')), stage=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.failureStage', '')), eventId=tostring(column_ifexists('attributes.eventId', '')), canWrite=tobool(column_ifexists('attributes.canWrite', false)), ageMs=todouble(['attributes.pendingAgeMs']), online=tobool(['attributes.online'])
| where isempty(environment_filter) or ['attributes.environment'] == environment_filter
| where isempty(release_filter) or release == release_filter
| where isempty(component_filter) or component == component_filter
| where isempty(operation_filter) or operation == operation_filter
| where body == 'operation.completed'
| where ['attributes.sampled'] == true and category != 'internal'
| project _time, trace_id, operation, component, release
| order by _time desc
| take 30
